summary: Full-stack Spoilancer testing PASSED. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests passed (100%) including root, /api/auth/me (valid token, missing header -> 401, bogus token -> 401), /api/auth/session bogus id -> 401, /api/advisor/analyze without auth -> 401, and /api/advisor/analyze with seeded Bearer 'test-token-abc' returning valid Gemini 3 Flash structured JSON with all 5 keys (summary, overall_health, limit_suggestions, spoilance_suggestion, tips) in ~7s. Frontend: 41/42 UI flow checks passed via Playwright (390x844 mobile viewport). Verified: login screen (both buttons), continue-offline -> onboarding, stipend input, add-field editor modal + all 4 validations (empty title, bad amount, hour>23, minute>59), copy-previous-day appears on Tue+ and copies fields, spoilance presets & alloc input, onboarding-finish -> strict gate (scheduled 0:01 was in the past) -> logging drops to 0 -> Home. Home shows savings ₹21,487 & spoilance ₹7,193 hero cards, edit-balances modal opens, all quick actions render (edit-limits, advisor, parse-sms, history) plus spoilance-logger-fab. Limits screen day-chip-0 & limits-add-button work. Spoilance Logger stepper, item rows, running-total and save-spoilance-button all render. Parse SMS input detects '₹250' from 'Rs 250 debited'. Profile: setting-language, -reminders, -limits, -app, -signout, -wipe all present; App Settings shows reminders-switch. No React Native red screens, no crashes, no deprecated Expo packages (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch). Only minor: React Native web deprecation warnings ('shadow*' style props, 'props.pointerEvents') printed as warnings — these do NOT break functionality and originate from RN-web internals / expo-notifications on web. No blockers found.

react_native_issues.issue: Runtime console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Emitted by react-native-web from GlassCard/Toast styles. Non-blocking but should be migrated to boxShadow for RN-web parity.
Runtime console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking, but a component is passing pointerEvents as a prop instead of as a style key.

action_items: Cosmetic: migrate any remaining 'shadow*' style props to 'boxShadow' (RN-web) to silence deprecation warnings. Search src/components for shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius on web.
Cosmetic: remove/replace `pointerEvents=...` prop usage with `style={{ pointerEvents: ... }}` in whichever component triggers the RN-web warning.
Optional: the seeded Bearer token expires 2026-08-24. Keep the seed script idempotent if this environment is torn down and rebuilt after that date.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py auth guard correctly returns 401 (not 403) for missing/invalid Authorization header — matches spec.
server.py excludes MongoDB _id in all reads via projection ({'_id': 0}) — good.
Advisor JSON parsing has safe fallback that returns a default schema if the LLM output is not clean JSON — resilient.
EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is loaded from env (backend/.env), no hardcoding.

Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL correctly (note: the app uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, not EXPO_BACKEND_URL — my tests read the same key from frontend/.env to hit the public URL, which works).
All interactive elements referenced in the review request have matching testID props — comprehensive coverage.
